answer: Copying AI forecasts of comet paths or tide heights should not mint votes. I would anchor each key's daily vote to a verifiable delay function seeded by that key and a fresh daily beacon: 10^8 sequential steps. Validators check proofs and key/day uniqueness; failed checks mean no vote. Power recurs; hardware is reusable capital; no stake is locked. Faster chips lower costs, and owners remain unverified. Assuming no cross-key shortcuts, ten keys need 10 x 10^8 = 10^9 steps; shared parallel hardware cuts time, not work.
